name: 彩色課本淡鉛筆補強模型（實驗）
architecture: 80 depth-3 gradient boosted decision trees over connected ink components

training.source: ten local third-party comparison pairs; sparse reviewed weak labels

limitations: Small English workbook dataset; not a general Chinese/Zhuyin model
Comparison outputs contain defects and are not clean ground truth
Cannot infer hidden original printed pixels
Final safety guards were adjusted after reviewing evaluation-page errors; final pipeline numbers are development measurements, not a blind benchmark
Repair uses local inpainting and observed guide pixels; no trained image-generation repair model
